name: stretch-in
title: Stretch In
description: Letters fly in from off-canvas and smear horizontally on the way: a vertex-lag deformation, not a scale.
useWhen: A heavy display word needs a fast, physical entrance where the letterforms visibly deform: bars stretch long while stems keep their width.
Each letter enters on its own beat and snaps to rest crisp.
avoidWhen: The type is small or body-size: the smear reads at display sizes. Use per-character-rise.
You want a plain slide-in: use short-slide-right.
author: Remocn
